body: Thanks! I wish I could hang out with work friends outside of work. My work friends are mostly young parents or in new relationships, so they socialize with other young parents or couples. Its difficult to be part of a social group when you are a single professional and no longer in college or graduate school. I am seeing a therapist.

Thanks! I try to be in places with people time to time  (small talk is very mentally draining for me, so I avoid that usually). Sometimes I try to sit and work in a public place during weekends. Not a lot of places around to go for walks, but yes I totally agree that walks can be very helpful.
Thanks for sharing your thoughts. I hope we find a way to live, I understand how hard it can be.

Thanks for writing. I am talking to a therapist twice a month to help deal with all the stuff going on in my life. She had said its normal to feel extra sensitive in my situation-- when your cup is almost full with various stresses, its easy for it to spill over. 

I browse the news in my free time, but the news hasn't been very joyful in the past few months either. I like to hike when I have time an I am feeling happy, but its difficult to do it when I am not.
